Five ingots with composition, I: Ti64Fe22Nb14, II: Ti66Nb18Fe16, III: Ti63Fe23Nb8Sn6, IV: Ti60Fe23Nb8Sn9 and V: Ti44Fe34Nb16Sn6 (at.%), were prepared by arc melting high-purity elements (Ti (99.9 %), Nb (99.8 %), electrolytic Fe (99.9 %) and Sn (99.99 %)) in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere.

The ingots were used to cast two different rapid solidified samples using an Discovery Cu-mold suction casting (EDG model): wedge shape sample and rods with 3 mm in diameter and 70 mm in length. The cooling rate applied to the samples is directly proportional to their thickness [22] ranging from 10 K/s (top part - wedge shape sample) to 10^3 K/s (tip part – wedge shape sample).
